anticheat_project_identity_check.name: anticheat_project_identity_check
anticheat_project_identity_check.value: "anticheat_project"."modrinth_id" IS NOT NULL OR "anticheat_project"."curseforge_id" IS NOT NULL OR "anticheat_project"."declared_mod_id" IS NOT NULL

economy_account_kind_fields.name: economy_account_kind_fields
economy_account_kind_fields.value: ("economy_account"."kind" = 'personal' and "economy_account"."handle" is null and "economy_account"."type" is null) or ("economy_account"."kind" = 'shared' and "economy_account"."handle" is not null and "economy_account"."owner_user_id" is null and "economy_account"."type" is not null)

event_team_size_check.name: event_team_size_check
event_team_size_check.value: ("event"."team_mode" AND "event"."team_min" >= 2 AND "event"."team_max" >= "event"."team_min" AND "event"."team_max" <= 32) OR (NOT "event"."team_mode" AND "event"."team_min" IS NULL AND "event"."team_max" IS NULL)
